source: 24. How should a production ZXNAME0000XZ system handle freshness, provenance, updates, deletions, and re-indexing? [Advanced - Production] ZXNAME0001XZ is only as fresh as the source-to-index pipeline. Store stable source IDs, version or revision identifiers, timestamps, provenance, and ingestion status. Updates should propagate to all derived artifacts: parsed text, chunks, embeddings, lexical indexes, graph structures, caches, and citation mappings. Deletion is especially important because removing a source record but leaving an old embedding or cached prompt can continue to expose stale or prohibited text. Decide whether updates are event-driven, batched, or periodic based on the freshness ZXNAME0002XZ, and measure ingestion lag explicitly. During migrations, support dual indexes or versioned rollouts so queries do not mix incompatible representations. The original attraction of non-parametric memory was that knowledge can be updated without retraining the generator; that advantage only exists if the engineering system actually maintains index freshness and lineage. zh: 24. 生产 ZXNAME0000XZ 系统应如何处理新鲜度、出处、更新、删除和重新索引？ [高级 - 生产] ZXNAME0001XZ 仅与源到索引管道一样新鲜。存储稳定的源 ID、版本或修订标识符、时间戳、出处和摄取状态。更新应该传播到所有派生的工件：解析的文本、块、嵌入、词汇索引、图形结构、缓存和引文映射。删除尤其重要，因为删除源记录但保留旧的嵌入或缓存的提示可能会继续暴露陈旧或禁​​止的文本。根据新鲜度 ZXNAME0002XZ 确定更新是事件驱动的、批量的还是定期的，并明确测量摄取延迟。在迁移期间，支持双索引或版本化部署，以便查询不会混合不兼容的表示。非参数记忆最初的吸引力在于可以更新知识而无需重新训练生成器；只有当工程系统真正保持索引的新鲜度和沿袭性时，这种优势才存在。 [1]
